It was a pleasure seeing you today. My name is Dr. Jeffrey Jenks and you can contact me if you have any questions. The clinic number is 1-800-926-8273 and fax number 619-471-9275.
I am not sure what is causing your knee pain, but it is most likely something similar to patellofemoral pain syndrome. As discussed I think osteoarthritis or a blood clot are much less likely.
If this does not improve within the next couple weeks let me know. In the meantime I would try ice, non-steroidal anti-inflammatories, and gentle stretching.
Electronically signed by Jeffrey Daniel Jenks at 10/22/2018 8:24 AM PDT

**#Bilateral knee pain:** Left knee pain largely resolved, right knee pain persisting. Localized to anterior right knee at patella. Pain decreases when he moves as did application of heat or ice. Most likely patellofemoral pain syndrome or something similar. Doubt deep vein trombosis given location and lack of swelling, although possible. No signs of fracture or dislocation.
